families.core_pattern: Locale-neutral and locale-variant curriculum graph with 519678 records, a curated 35-concept/76-prerequisite DAG, exact evidence mappings, and a SQLite query layer.
demonstrated_strengths: Best pedagogical graph in the comparison.
families.learner_runtime_status: No proven live consumer.
limitations: Extremely heavy: 1.84 GB plus a 1.13-GB SQLite database.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established in the audited entry; deterministic two-build identity is established.

families.core_pattern: Append-only 452387-record translation/control history with UUIDv5 identity, explicit missing-solution states, and lossless JSONL/CSV.
families.learner_runtime_status: No learner runtime use is reported; the model is described as structural rather than learner-route oriented.
limitations: Primarily structural rather than a learner-route graph.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Lossless JSONL/CSV exchange is established.

families.core_pattern: Strict module projections with fixed-point selection, isolated two-build candidates, and fail-closed cursor-last admission/recovery.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established; projections exist, but export lag and three overlay dialects fragment consumption.

families.core_pattern: Consumer-specific JSON, JSONL, and CSV views sharing bilingual segment identity.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Pragmatic exchange is established; exact reversibility is not explicitly proved.

families.core_pattern: Exercise-closure packet over a strict graph with statement, hint, answer, and solution subtrees, rights, and deterministic roundtrip.
families.learner_runtime_status: No runtime consumer exists.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Deterministic roundtrip is established.

families.core_pattern: Source-bound incremental registry using native IDs, direct-text hashes, declared topology deltas, marker-bound LaTeX variants, and fail-closed drift checks.
demonstrated_strengths: Used in real production and release.
Komposit identity `(native_profile, native_id)` mencegah flattening lintas profil.
Target-first exact mappings dan lineage_only rows mempertahankan loss accounting.
Hak, marker, topology, Q/H/A/S dan status terjemahan dipertahankan per profil.
JSONL/CSV deterministik, namespace sidecar stream-validated, dan negative probes fail-closed.
Tujuh rute PDF whole-file learner-first dicatat dengan byte, halaman, URL, dan SHA-256.
families.learner_runtime_status: Tujuh rute PDF whole-file learner-first; data adapter sekunder dan tidak diklaim dikonsumsi PDF.
limitations: Prosa tidak dipusatkan; empat backend owner-native tetap menjadi otoritas.
Belum ada HTML course-native, EPUB, atau rute unit/fragmen yang dibuktikan.
Baca-balik publik paket adapter successor belum dilakukan pada snapshot ini.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Paket common-v2.3.1 tersegel dan replay lokal lulus; publikasi successor masih pending.

families.core_pattern: Fine hashed CNXML text and attribute slots with explicit problem, solution, asset, and accessibility relations.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
limitations: Reverse CNXML reconstruction was not proved.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Reverse CNXML reconstruction was not proved.

families.core_pattern: UUID/alias family catalog with explicit hint-only/no-answer states and exact legacy-locator checks.

Retained micro-checkpoint history dominates the machinery.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established in the audited entry.

families.core_pattern: Operational course catalog with executable mastery units, exercises, artifacts, and prerequisite routes.

families.reversible_exchange_status: No reversible/common exchange.

399020415 bytes across 948 files, including 910 evidence files.

families.core_pattern: One 3323-unit graph producing two nonduplicating course views with 6505 typed relations, persistent birth/current identities, source-frozen state, corrections, and deterministic self-contained exchange.

limitations: Course selectors are not exposed as distinct learner navigation.

families.learner_runtime_status: A reader exists, but TeX rather than the backend drives it.

families.core_pattern: Exact parallel source/target PreTeXt graphs with 19048 records and a strong concept/prerequisite model.

families.core_pattern: Compact additive unit, exercise, hint, and figure catalogs directly consumed to build semantic HTML and EPUB.

families.core_pattern: Tea Time backend with deterministic pack/merge, experiment records, exact toolchain receipts, one-byte drift rejection, and lossless open export.

families.core_pattern: Paired source/target hashes, mastery triples, notebooks, and project packets; the manager adapter maps 4941 native records and reconstructs 81 files.

methodology.comparison_policy: Scores are omitted where false precision would hide scope differences. Size, schema validation, or manager admission alone does not establish learner usefulness.
methodology.design_premise: Independent native backend designs were intentional and are being compared for synthesis.

stages.description_id: Inventarisasi setiap rancangan backend native tanpa memaksakan bentuk pusat.
Bandingkan identitas, relasi, provenance, replay, akses belajar, dan biaya pemeliharaan pada sumbu yang sama.
Adopsi hanya fitur yang dibuktikan oleh artefak dan nyatakan batas yang belum ditutup.
Bangun deterministik, validasi, publikasikan, baca balik anonim, lalu audit ulang snapshot berikutnya.
